landing.description: The 7-Day AI Workbook: one real task, seven days, the CLEAR system. $9.

data.headline: The 7-Day AI Workbook
data.sub: One real task, seven days, the CLEAR system
data.image_alt: Cover of The 7-Day AI Workbook by Elvin Peters

paras: Pick one task from your own work and carry it through seven days. Each day teaches one stage of the CLEAR system from The Artificial Advantage. By Day 7 you’ve finished a piece of your own work, saved a template you can reuse and measured the difference between your first try and your last.

data.heading: A look at Day 1
data.first_alt: Workbook page 4, Day 1: The Director’s Mindset. It shows today’s skill, a short note on taking the director’s chair, and the start of the Task Card with lines to fill in: the task in one sentence, who it is for, and what done looks like.
data.second_alt: Workbook page 5, the rest of Day 1: the last Task Card lines (what I currently do step by step, how long it takes me now), a Check yourself box, and a note that tomorrow you pick your tool and run the task once.

items.name: A Task Card that turns one real task into your practice project
Seven daily exercises, one per day, that cover all five CLEAR stages, each with a fill-in section and a check-yourself question
The RTC brief, the Diagnostic Ladder and the Two-Step Verification Method, explained step by step
A before-and-after comparison so you can see the change in your own work
A one-page CLEAR loop you can reuse for any task
A chapter pointer on every day for readers who want to go deeper

data.heading: Format and delivery
paras: An 18-page PDF, Letter size. Instant download plus an email. For your own use.
